title: Better Offline Diagnostics & UI Positioning
changes: Admin logs now show the full URL being checked during connectivity verification (e.g., 'Fetching: https://example.com/version.json?t=...').
Offline notification banner moved from top of screen to fixed bottom position, so it no longer covers important interface elements.
Offline banner stays hidden during startup until the first connectivity check completes, preventing false 'offline' alerts when you're actually online.
Connectivity logs include HTTP response codes and clearer success/failure indicators (✓ for success, ✗ for failure).
Admin logging system captures all offline detection events in real-time for easy troubleshooting.
